title: stachys dregeana var. lasiocalyx
intro: Stachys dregeana var. lasiocalyx, commonly known as the 'Cape Catmint', is a plant species found in the Cape Province of South Africa. The Cape Catmint is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential applications in traditional medicine.
